summary.en: A quiz event held as part of IGNITE 2016, open to students of classes 8 to 12.
summary.kn: ಇಗ್ನೈಟ್ 2016ರ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿ ನಡೆದ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮ; 8ರಿಂದ 12ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಮುಕ್ತ.

body: Mindbenders 2016 was a quiz and mental challenge event organized to test the intellectual capabilities of participants and promote healthy academic competition among the alumni community.

documents.alt: Poster for Mindbenders, the quiz event held as part of IGNITE 2016 on 3 December.
